items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: And he obviously he lived about a year behind Jan May didn't he?

ctx.x: Mmhmm. Did you ever know Shade? You told me you knew Will Shade.

Oh I know him. Oh yeah. He was living right down the street here. Before he died. He got five or six doves down the street there. He just got sick you know. Lang around a long time. He was sick for five or six years. And his wife. His wife died before he did. Mmhmm. And he obviously he lived about a year behind Jan May didn't he?
